raw:
“My first crop of strawberries on the balcony—that made me happy. There were six ripe berries, all in one bowl. Six doesn’t sound like a great harvest, but when they’re your own, it feels different. I kept looking at them and thinking, those actually grew here, on my balcony.

I saved two for a neighbor. That was part of the pleasure, having enough to share, even if ‘enough’ was only six. And then, of course, once you’ve set two aside, the bowl looks a bit emptier, but I liked knowing what those two were for.

I work as a supply clerk at an aquarium shop, so I’m used to thinking about quantities. But those weren’t just six of something. They were my first strawberries. That was what I kept coming back to.”
